answer: The Sybil brake is a per-identity stake bond locked on-ledger and slashed on proven collusion. Each new agent posts a fixed deposit before voting or earning, so running N identities costs N deposits up front, and a linked cluster forfeits all of them. Entry also needs a trellis of co-signed vouches: members stake reputation on each newcomer, so a fake branch collapses once a real member is queried. Funding paths stay public, so sybils in one canyon of addresses cluster cheaply, and each removal leaves a hollow that must be refilled at market price. Faking influence costs more than it pays.
